Livestock source: Sheep-dominated grazing livestock; among the highest corrected sheep counts (10,230).
Pathway to production area: Surface runoff; ED borders BMPA; Bellagarvaun river; areas of extreme groundwater vulnerability in east.
Groundwater / landscape context: High animal loading combined with vulnerable terrain and short pathways.
Survey interpretation: Survey identifies this as the greatest agricultural contamination concern for licensed sites.
Use in GOBLIN-Spatial: Strong application case: high SOURCE magnitude plus strong PATHWAY connectivity. Useful for testing whether livestock abundance alone is insufficient.

Pathway to production area: Surface runoff; Creggan and Tullaghan rivers.
Receptor proximity / licensed sites: Outflows >4.74 km from nearest licensed site T10-311.
Groundwater / landscape context: Agricultural source present, but receptor pathway is longer than Ballycroy South.
Survey interpretation: Important source area but lower direct receptor relevance than Ballycroy South.
Use in GOBLIN-Spatial: Useful contrast case for Source vs Pathway separation.

Pathway to production area: Owenmore and Tarsaghaunmore rivers; Tarsaghaunmore flows to Owenduff; extreme groundwater vulnerability in west.
Receptor proximity / licensed sites: Owenmore enters BMPA >19 km from nearest licensed site; Owenduff pathway >12.6 km.
Groundwater / landscape context: High livestock source but long hydrological pathway.
Survey interpretation: Potential source significance moderated by distance/connectivity.
Use in GOBLIN-Spatial: Useful example of high livestock signature with weaker receptor connectivity.

Pathway to production area: Munhin river subbasin, flowing to Owenmore.
